name: first-reply
desc: The first reply worker-base.md §0.3 asks for.

checks.desc: at least 3 file paths (root files like README.md count)
a part on answered / defaulted decisions
under the 'first 5 IDs' heading: 5 distinct IDs in full, in the order written (v3, R6-PRM-084: v2 counted any 5 IDs anywhere, so free-form replies passed)
a part on owner-only / blocked items
a part on dependencies on other lanes

jev.instructions: The REPLY lists, by path, the specific files its author read before starting work.
The REPLY has a part listing exactly the first five work item IDs its author will do, each written in full (like R6-ABC-001, never shortened to 002), in the order they will be done.
